prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Make ONE original square premium painterly naturalistic Mythics illustration, 1024x1024 or larger, of a majestic CHINESE RAIN DRAGON, specifically the four-legged horned Chinese dragon race of the Lung-Wang tradition. NOT a European dragon. One enormous long lithe serpentine body with ONE head, TWO natural non-glowing eyes, a camel-like forehead, branching STAG HORNS, OX-LIKE EARS, long snake neck, carp scales, broad sea-monster belly, exactly FOUR clearly distinct LEGS ending in EAGLE CLAWS with tiger-like paw pads, and ONE tapering tail. NO wings, no fire, no extra limbs, no whisker tentacles or head spines. Put the body in a spacious sweeping side-three-quarter S curve across the square, with two separated front legs extending below the front torso and two separated hind legs below the rear torso; every leg attaches visibly to the same body and ends in one clearly readable clawed paw. Full head, all four legs, tail and both antlers entirely inside frame. The dragon floats low above a river and a small ancient Chinese valley settlement, rain sweeping beneath it, monumental low camera perspective and dramatic thunderclouds. Two distant jagged atmospheric lightning strokes behind its body and dense falling RAIN show its documented rain/thunder domain; lightning must not come from eyes or paws. Its fearsome but intelligent expression is noble and benevolent, a powerful living rain-bringer, not an attacking demon. Bronze-olive carp scales, dark wet stones and jade-grey river, cinematic storm lighting and rich realistic painted texture. No hoard, no Western bat wings, no burning villages, no humans in danger, no victims, no hybrid cultures, no copied movie/game/anime/comic designs, no text/letters/logos/borders/watermarks, no gore or nudity.
